 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Sharma
 Or
% 18.05.2023 Crl.M.A. 13424/2023 (Exemption)
1 . Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.

2.  The application is disposed of accordingly.
3.

The present application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. seeks regular bail in case FIR No.
200/2023, under Sections 363/365/366A/370/372/376/506/120B/201/190 of the IPC and Sections 4/8 of the POCSO Act, 2012, registered at P.S. Inderpuri, West, Delhi.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks some time to file the status report.
Let the same be filed before the next date of hearing.
Let the latest nominal roll with respect to the present applicant be requisitioned from the concerned Jail Superintendent.
This is a digitally signed order.
